description: Defines a custom exception class 'MessageMapperConfigurationInvalidException' used for signaling invalid configuration of message mappers within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity model. Includes builder pattern for creating instances, methods for constructing from messages or JSON, and references to related classes and constants.

classes.name: MessageMapperConfigurationInvalidException
classes.description: Custom exception class indicating invalid message mapper configuration, immutable, extends DittoRuntimeException, implements ConnectivityException.

classes.name: MessageMapperConfigurationInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: Fluent builder class for constructing instances of MessageMapperConfigurationInvalidException, not thread-safe.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for MessageMapperConfigurationInvalidException with specified missing property.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Constructs an exception instance from a message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an exception instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
